parts.title: Task 1
parts.passage_text:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The two pictures show a typical Japanese office and a typical American office.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

parts.title: Task 2
parts.passage_text: As most people spend a major part of their adult life at work, job satisfaction is an important element of individual well-being. What factors contribute to job satisfaction? How realistic is the expectation of job satisfaction for all workers?
